title: Toward stable operation for thermochemical conversion of biomass and waste: ash chemistry for understanding ash adhesion at high temperatures
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SU00397K, Critical Review
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Genki Horiguchi, Yohei Okada
Synthetic ash with well-designed chemical characteristics enables a mechanistic understanding of the impact of ash chemistry on adhesion. This review surveys recent studies in which synthetic ashes were used to understand ash adhesion.
